auth.title: Sign in to Ricotdin
auth.subtitle: Continue to your meetings, notes, and assistant.

errors.missing: Enter your email or username and your password.
errors.invalid_credentials: That email, username or password is not right.
errors.email_not_verified: Please verify your email first. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.account_disabled: This account has been disabled. Contact an administrator.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

auth.signOutFailed: We could not end your session on the server. On a shared computer, sign in and sign out again, or close the browser.

page.comingSoon: This screen is being connected to the new backend.

profile.title: Profile & preferences

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.subtitle: The page you are looking for does not exist.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.subtitle: You need administrator rights to open this page.

admin.subtitle: Manage your workspace infrastructure, access, and operations.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page hit an unexpected error. Reload to try again.
error.config: The app is not configured correctly. Contact an administrator.
error.unavailable: Cannot reach the server right now. Check your connection, then try again.

record.stopped: Recorded {{time}} ({{size}}). Listen back, then upload it for processing.
record.noTabAudio: No tab or system audio is being recorded — only your microphone. To include the other participants, stop, start again and tick "Share tab audio" in the sharing dialog.
record.noTabAudioAfter: This recording has only your microphone: tab or system audio was not shared.

card.title: Record this meeting
card.body: Capture your microphone and tab or system audio securely in your browser.

notice.title: Before you record
notice.body: This app will record and transcribe the meeting. Everyone taking part should know about the recording and agree to it before you start. Recording laws vary by location.
notice.script: “Before we begin: I'm going to record this meeting so I can transcribe it and take notes. Please let me know now if you don't want to be recorded.”

unsupported.title: This browser cannot record meetings
unsupported.body: Use a recent Chrome or Edge on a computer. You can still upload a recording below. Missing:

missing.codec: A supported audio format (WebM, Ogg or MP4)

errors.denied: Permission denied — allow microphone and screen access, then try again.
errors.noMic: No microphone found — connect a microphone and try again.
errors.state: The recorder stopped unexpectedly — try again.
errors.generic: Recording could not start. Try again.

record.leaveConfirm: You have a recording or upload in progress. Leave this page and lose it?

upload.drop: Drop an audio or video file here
upload.formats: MP3, M4A, WAV, AAC, OGG, FLAC, WEBM or video (MP4, MOV, AVI, MKV, M4V) · max {{max}}
upload.done: Uploaded. Processing has started — it usually takes a few minutes.

errors.type: Unsupported file type “{{ext}}”. Use an audio or video file.
errors.size: The file is too large. The maximum is {{max}}.
errors.network: Upload interrupted — check your connection and try again.
errors.tooMany: Too many uploads right now. Wait a while, or delete unfinished uploads, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Storage is not available right now. Try again later.
errors.drive: The file could not be stored. Try again.
errors.confirm: The file was uploaded but could not be checked. Open your meetings list, or try again.
errors.avatarType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
errors.avatarSize: The image must be smaller than 2 MB.
